messages:
Sara: Heads-up — customer (acme) sees console billing estimator spike for embeddings. numbers look 3-4x higher than expected. seems correlated with our JS SDK sending mixed-dim arrays in one request.
Devon: repro please? sample request/headers?
Sara: repro attached inline. quick example:
```json
POST /v1/embeddings
Body: {"vectors": [[0.1,0.2, ...], [0.3,...,0.4, ... (length 768)], [ ... length 384]] }
Headers: Authorization: Bearer ...\n         Content-Type: application/json
``` 
The SDK currently sets a best-effort estimate header `x-estimated-units: 42` using the first vector's dim when it can't inspect everything (optimization). that heuristic wrongly inflates our console estimator which mixes dim heuristics + rough bytes -> units conversion.
Devon: ack. sdk did that to avoid iterating large payloads for performance. we trade accuracy for CPU.
Mike: telemetry-wise we're only logging preflight_estimate and server_actual_units. if the SDK header is present we swallow it and attribute to client_estimate. that's polluting per-tenant rollups.
Cheng: ingested log from ingest-bot shows this pattern:
ingest-bot: preflight-miss tenant=acme reason=dim-mismatch estimate=42 payload_bytes=~1.2MB actual_units=11
Sara: exactly — UI shows 42 in the heatmap for that tenant, then actual is 11 and users get confused/billing questions.
Jess: product note — customers see spikes in "estimated units" column in console. we need a quick UX mitigation (hide client-provided estimate?) and longer fix.
Devon: quick mitigation: server should prefer server-side byte-based estimate when payload_bytes < threshold or when dims vary inside request. we can ignore `x-estimated-units` if mismatch detected.
Cheng: agree. algorithm idea: if vectors have mixed dims OR content-length header != computed bytes, mark estimate as "untrusted" and use bytes->units conversion. add flag `estimator.v2` to toggle.
Mike: add telemetry: metric `embed.estimator.trust_override` with tags {tenant, reason}. histogram `embed.estimate.error_pct` (abs(server-est)/server).
Sara: fsr, propose SDK change: export a cheap `estimateUnitsExact()` that iterates dims but only for small payloads (<256KB) and otherwise drop the dim-heuristic. we should also add explicit header `x-embed-shape: 768,384`? but header length could get big for many vectors.
Devon: header per-vector not possible. maybe `x-embed-dominant-dim: 768` and `x-embed-mixed: true`. that keeps header small but gives server hint.
Jess: console changes: display "estimate source" column (server | client_hint | unknown) and add tooltip explaining heuristics so customers aren't alarmed. can we ship UI change in 2 weeks?
Cheng: rollout plan: 1) server: implement estimator.v2 behind feature-flag; 2) collect metrics for 48h in canary; 3) enable for 10% tenants; 4) flip and roll out.
Mike: add a lightweight alert when estimate error_pct > 2x for top-n tenants so SRE/product ops can watch.
Sara: action items:
- Devon: SDK PR to stop using first-vector-dim heuristic for payloads <-> 1718230000 (ETA EOD)
- Cheng: server feature-flag + estimator.v2 implementation + telemetry (metric names above) -> 1718270000 (ETA 3 days)
- Mike: dashboard delta: add estimate_source & error_pct tiles to console -> 1718330000 (ETA 1 week)
- Jess: update help text & customer comms draft -> 1718320000 (ETA 3 days)
Devon: noted. will also add opt-in env var in SDK `REDWOOD_EMBED_ESTIMATE_STRICT=true` for early adopters.
ingest-bot: scheduled job: run backfill to compute historical estimate_error for last 30 days for tenants with >100 requests.
Sara: thanks. marking this thread for follow-up after canary. :thumbsup:
